# The refuted_pattern regexes are therefore all permissive-token patterns, and the table was

# refutations (Gibbon) misled p226's own self-audit into "correcting" a right cell to a wrong one.
# COLUMN COMPATIBILITY: columns 1-6 are IDENTICAL in order and semantics to p226's
# sh-refuted-claims, so every p224/p225/p226 instrument reads this file unchanged.
# Column 7 (direction) is APPENDED and is new in p227.
#   direction = PERMISSIVE  -> the circulating claim is MORE permissive than the truth.
#                              Cost: a compliance breach. This is what p224-p226 could see.
#   direction = RESTRICTIVE -> the circulating claim is MORE restrictive than the truth.
#                              Cost: a buildable repo wrongly excluded from an engagement.
#                              A commercial loss, and no sweep before p227 was built to find it.
